templates.title: 一定会发生／可能发生／一定不会发生

templates.title: 小棒搭图形的规律

stem.zh: 杰丝用小棒搭图形：图形 1、图形 2、图形 3 的样子如下图。照这个规律，搭图形 {n} 一共要用多少根小棒？

solution.en: Each new triangle shares a side with the previous one, so every extra triangle only needs 2 more sticks: 3, 5, 7, … Shape {n} needs 3 + 2×({n}−1) = {2*n+1} sticks.

templates.title: 电梯上上下下（出到地上楼层）

stem.zh: 卡拉从下图这栋楼的 B{b} 层进了电梯。电梯上升了 {u} 层，又下降了 {d} 层，然后她出了电梯。她是在地上几楼出的电梯？（G 是地面层，地上从 1 楼数起）

solution.en: Treat B{b} as −{b}: −{b}+{u}−{d}＝{0-b+u-d}. Negative means below ground, i.e. level B{0-(0-b+u-d)}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 轮流倒数数到谁

stem.zh: 四个小伙伴（Sue、Jim、Dave、Kate）围成一圈轮流往下倒数，数数的顺序和头几个数如下图。照这样数下去，「{n}」会轮到谁说？
stem.en: Four friends (Sue, Jim, Dave and Kate) take turns counting backwards around a circle; the order and the first few numbers are shown below. Who will say "{n}"?

solution.zh:
从图上看，四个人的顺序是 Sue → Jim → Dave → Kate（Sue 是第 1 个），依次报一个数，轮一圈。
从 {S} 数到 {n} 一共报了 {S}−{n}＝{S-n} 个数，{S-n}÷4 的余数是 {(S-n)%4}，所以要数到顺序里的第 {(S-n)%4+1} 个人（第 1 个是 Sue）。
solution.en:
From the picture the order is Sue → Jim → Dave → Kate (Sue is 1st) and the four repeat round the circle.
Counting from {S} down to {n} takes {S}−{n}＝{S-n} numbers; {S-n}÷4 leaves remainder {(S-n)%4}, so it is number {(S-n)%4+1} in that order (number 1 is Sue).

templates.title: 正方形围栏要多少根柱子

stem.en: A farmer wants a square paddock. He puts {p} posts on each side, with one post at each corner (corner posts are shared by two sides). How many posts does he need in total?

solution.en: Simply 4×{p}＝{4*p} would count each corner post twice, so subtract 4. Total = 4×{p}−4＝{4*p-4} posts.
solution.zh: 如果直接 4×{p}＝{4*p}，四个角的柱子就被数了两次，要多减去 4。所以一共 4×{p}−4＝{4*p-4} 根。

看图中的灯笼串：颜色 4 个一组不停重复（第 1 个红、第 2 个黄、第 3 个蓝、第 4 个绿，第 5 个又回到红）。
第 {n} 个灯笼，前面已经有 {g} 个完整的 4 个一组（{g}×4＝{g*4} 个），所以它是下一组里的第 {q} 个。
对照顺序：每组第 1 个红、第 2 个黄、第 3 个蓝、第 4 个绿 —— 第 {q} 个对应的颜色就是答案。
solution.en:
In the picture the colours repeat in a group of 4 (1st red, 2nd yellow, 3rd blue, 4th green; the 5th is red again).
Before the {n}th lantern there are {g} complete groups of 4 ({g}×4＝{g*4}), so it is number {q} in the next group.
In each group: 1st red, 2nd yellow, 3rd blue, 4th green — read off the colour for position {q}.

stem.en: Anna has plenty of 5c, 10c, 20c and 50c coins (diagram below). She must pay exactly {amt}c and wants to use AS MANY coins as possible. What is the greatest number of coins she can use?

solution.zh: 想用的硬币最多，就要尽量用最小面值的 5 分硬币：{amt} ÷ 5 = {T}（枚），而且 {amt} 正好是 5 的倍数，所以最多 {T} 枚。
solution.en: To use the most coins, use the smallest value (5c) as much as possible: {amt} ÷ 5 = {T} coins.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 补全桌面的花纹

stem.zh: 本的桌面铺着蓝黄相间的方砖（如下图），红色虚线框里缺了一块 2×2 的补块。补块应该是什么样子的？
stem.en: Ben's table top is tiled in a blue/yellow checker pattern (diagram below); a 2×2 patch is missing inside the red dashed box. What should the missing patch look like?

solution.zh: 把补块按桌面花纹的行列一格一格接上去：横向、纵向都是蓝黄交替，缺口从第 {rr} 行第 {cc} 列开始，四格的颜色就被唯一确定了。
solution.en: Line the patch up with the rows and columns: the pattern alternates both ways, and the gap starts at row {rr}, column {cc}, so the four colours are fixed.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 三张纸的倍数关系

stem.zh: 鲍比有三张长方形纸，下图按实际大小画出了它们（同样宽，长度不同）。黄色（yellow）纸的大小是红色（red）纸的 {m} 倍，红色纸是蓝色（blue）纸的 {k} 倍。一张黄色纸能正好铺满多少张蓝色纸？
stem.en: Bobby has three rectangular sheets, drawn to scale below (same width, different lengths). The yellow sheet is {m} times the size of the red sheet, and the red sheet is {k} times the size of the blue sheet. How many blue sheets exactly cover one yellow sheet?

solution.zh: 红纸是蓝纸的 {k} 倍，黄纸又是红纸的 {m} 倍，所以黄纸是蓝纸的 {k}×{m}＝{m*k} 倍 —— 要 {m*k} 张蓝纸才能正好铺满一张黄纸。
solution.en: Red is {k} times blue and yellow is {m} times red, so yellow is {k}×{m}＝{m*k} times blue: {m*k} blue sheets cover one yellow sheet.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 棋盘上走子

stem.zh: 西塔的棋子（蓝点）在黑白棋盘上，西塔站在棋盘的上方、马克站在下方（如下图）。她把棋子往「自己的」左边移 1 格，再朝马克的方向前移 2 格。棋子最后停在哪一格？
stem.en: Sita's counter (blue dot) is on the black-and-white board. Sita stands above the board and Mark stands below it (see the diagram). She moves the counter 1 square to her own left, then 2 squares forward toward Mark. On which square does it land?

solution.zh:
西塔站在棋盘上方、面朝下方的马克，所以她自己的「左边」就是画面的右边。
从蓝点出发：先向右（她的左边）1 格，再向下（朝马克的方向）2 格 —— 落到从上数第 {ar} 行、从左数第 {ac} 列。
solution.en:
Sita stands above the board facing Mark below, so her own left is the right-hand side of the picture.
From the blue dot: 1 square to the right (her left), then 2 squares down (toward Mark) — landing on row {ar}, column {ac} counting down and from the left.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 池塘边的鸟：飞来又飞走

stem.zh: 池塘里原有 {s} 只鸟。蒂娜每隔 5 分钟记录一次飞来的和飞走的鸟数（见下表）。20 分钟后池塘里有多少只鸟？
stem.en: There were {s} birds on the pond. Tina recorded the birds arriving and flying away every 5 minutes (see the table). How many birds are on the pond after 20 minutes?

solution.zh: 把表里的每次变化依次算下来：{s}＋{a1}−{f1}＝{s+a1-f1}；{s+a1-f1}＋{a2}−{f2}＝{s+a1+a2-f1-f2}；再 {a3} 进 {f3} 出得 {s+a1+a2+a3-f1-f2-f3}；最后 {a4} 进 {f4} 出，得 {T} 只。
solution.en: Work through the table step by step: {s}+{a1}−{f1}＝{s+a1-f1}; then +{a2}−{f2}＝{s+a1+a2-f1-f2}; then +{a3}−{f3}＝{s+a1+a2+a3-f1-f2-f3}; finally +{a4}−{f4}＝{T}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 固定底座的积木塔

stem.zh: 吉娜有 {n} 块颜色不同的积木（见下图，每块颜色都不一样，颜色名写在积木上）。她想搭一座 {n} 层的高塔，其中绿色（green）积木必须在最底层。她能搭出多少座不一样的塔？
stem.en: Gina has {n} blocks, all different colours (see the picture). She builds towers {n} blocks high, and the green block must be at the bottom. How many different towers can she build?

solution.zh: 绿色（green）积木已经固定在最底层，剩下 {n-1} 个位置要把 {n-1} 种颜色的积木排进去：第一个位置有 {n-1} 种选法，第二个有 {n-2} 种，第三个有 {n-3} 种，所以一共 {n-1}×{n-2}×{n-3}＝{(n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)} 座。
solution.en: Green is fixed at the bottom; the remaining {n-1} places take the other {n-1} colours: {n-1}×{n-2}×{n-3}＝{(n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)} towers.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 三个算式求符号的值

stem.zh: 看下图的三道算式（◆、▲、● 各代表一个数）。● 代表的数是多少？
stem.en: Look at the three equations below (◆, ▲ and ● each stand for a number). What number does ● stand for?

solution.en: Equation 2 gives ▲+●＝{B/2}. Substituting into equation 1 gives ◆＝{A}−{B/2}＝{A-B/2}. Equation 3 can be regrouped as (◆+▲+●)+◆+●+●＝{C}; with ◆+▲+●＝{A} and ◆＝{A-B/2} this gives ●+●＝{C-2*A+B/2}, so ●＝{c}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 移动最少的猪使每个圈一样多

stem.zh: 农夫乔有 A、B、C、D 四个猪圈（如下图），猪只能按箭头方向从一个圈赶到相邻的下一个圈。他想让每个猪圈的猪一样多，最少要移动多少头猪？
stem.en: Farmer Joe has four pens A, B, C and D (diagram below); pigs may only be moved in the direction of the arrows into the next pen. He wants every pen to hold the same number of pigs. What is the fewest pigs he must move?

solution.zh: 四个圈一共 {tot} 头猪，平均每个圈 {a} 头。只能按 A→B→C→D 的方向赶：A 多 {f1} 头只能给 B；B 接着多 {f2} 头给 C；C 再多 {f3} 头给 D。一共要移动 {ans} 头。
solution.en: There are {tot} pigs in all, so {a} per pen. Pigs only move A→B→C→D: A passes {f1} on, B passes {f2}, C passes {f3}. Total moved: {ans}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 数一数笑脸有几个

stem.en: How many smiley faces are there?
stem.zh: 图里一共有多少个笑脸？

solution.en: Point at each face and count: {n} in all.
solution.zh: 指着一个个数：一共 {n} 个。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 规律中缺了哪个图形

stem.en: The shapes repeat in a pattern. Which shape is missing from the box with the question mark?
stem.zh: 图形按规律重复出现。问号框里缺的是哪个图形？

solution.en: The four shapes repeat in this order: 1 square, 2 triangle, 3 circle, 4 star. The box with the question mark is number {mark} along the row. {mark} ÷ 4 leaves {pos}, so it is number {pos} inside its group of four — the same shape that sits in position {pos}. Compare with the boxes you can see to check.
solution.zh: 四个图形按「正方形、三角形、圆形、星形」的顺序不停重复，也就是第 1 个正方形、第 2 个三角形、第 3 个圆形、第 4 个星形。问号框是这一行里的第 {mark} 个；{mark} ÷ 4 余 {pos}，说明它在自己那一轮里排第 {pos}，缺的就是排在这个位置上的图形。可以对着前面几轮数一数验证。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: {d} 天后是星期几

stem.en: The picture shows the days of the week and marks today. What day will it be in {d} day(s)?
stem.zh: 图里是一周的七天，上面标着 Today（今天）的那一格就是今天。再过 {d} 天是星期几？

solution.en: Start at the marked day and step forward {d} day(s) along the strip. The order is Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and then it starts again — counting {d} steps from today gives the answer.
solution.zh: 从深色的「今天」开始，顺着图往后数 {d} 格。顺序是星期一、二、三、四、五、六、日，数完七天再从头开始。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 两个人的划记相差几个

stem.en: The tally marks show how many goals Kate and Pete each scored. How many more goals did Kate score than Pete?
stem.zh: 划记表记录的是 Kate（凯特）和 Pete（彼得）各进了几个球。凯特比彼得多了几个？

solution.en: Read the tallies: Kate has {a}, Pete has {b}. One group of five is the fifth mark drawn across the other four. {a} - {b} = {d}.
solution.zh: 先读划记：每满五个是一组（第五笔横着划过去）。凯特 {a} 个，彼得 {b} 个，{a} − {b} = {d}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪两个图形完全一样

stem.en: Which two shapes are exactly the same shape and size?
stem.zh: 下面哪两个图形的大小和形状完全一样？

solution.en: Turning a shape around does not change it. One of the four is a square standing up and another is that same square turned 45°, so they are exactly the same. The tall diamond and the long rectangle are not squares, so they do not match anything.
solution.zh: 把图形转一下，形状和大小都没变。四格里有一格是正放的正方形，还有一格是它转 45° 的样子，这两个完全一样。又高又窄的菱形和细长的长方形都不是正方形，配不上。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪个数在两者之间

stem.en: Which number is between {lo} and {hi}?
stem.zh: 下面哪个数在 {lo} 和 {hi} 之间？

solution.en: {c} is bigger than {lo} and smaller than {hi}, so it is between them. {lo - 1} is too small; {hi + 1} and {hi + 5} are too big.
solution.zh: {c} 比 {lo} 大、比 {hi} 小，所以夹在中间。{lo - 1} 太小；{hi + 1} 和 {hi + 5} 太大了。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪些问题的答案是数

stem.en: Which TWO questions can be answered with a number? Choose two.
stem.zh: 下面哪「两个」问题的答案是一个数？（选两个）

options.en: How many pets do you have?

solution.en: "How many pets do you have?" is answered with a number of pets. "How old are you?" is answered with a number of years. A name and a yes/no answer are not numbers.
solution.zh: 「养了几只宠物」要用只数回答，「几岁了」要用岁数回答，这两个都是数。回答名字、回答「是/不是」都不是数。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每次加同一个数的数列

stem.en: The numbers go up by {d} each time: {s}, {s + d}, {s + 2 * d}, {s + 3 * d}, ... What is the next number?
stem.zh: 下面每个数都比前一个多 {d}：{s}、{s + d}、{s + 2 * d}、{s + 3 * d}……下一个数是多少？

solution.en: Each step adds {d}. From {s + 3 * d} add {d} again: {s + 3 * d} + {d} = {s + 4 * d}.

templates.noFigure: 数列本身已经写在题干里，不需要配图

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪张骨牌能和它配成一对

stem.en: Jim is matching dominoes by adding their spots together: two dominoes match when their spots add up to the SAME total. The figure shows a matching pair worked out for you. Which domino matches the one Jim picked up?
stem.zh: 吉姆把骨牌两半上的点数加起来配对：总数一样就算配成一对。图里已经给了一对做示范。哪张骨牌和吉姆拿起的这张配成一对？

solution.en: Add the two halves of every domino. Jim picked up {pa} + {pb} = {P}. So the matching domino must also add up to {P}: {ma} + {mb} = {P}. The other three add up to {g1a + g1b}, {g2a + g2b} and {g3a + g3b} — all different, so they cannot match.
solution.zh: 把每张骨牌两半的点数加起来。吉姆拿起的这张是 {pa} + {pb} = {P}。要和它配对，总数也得是 {P}：{ma} + {mb} = {P}。另外三张分别加起来是 {g1a + g1b}、{g2a + g2b}、{g3a + g3b}，都不一样，所以配不上。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 跟着箭头走，钥匙在哪盆花下面

stem.en: The key is hidden under one of the flower pots. Start at the house and follow the arrow, moving {n0} pot(s). Which colour pot is the key under?
stem.zh: 钥匙藏在其中一盆花的下面。从房子出发，按箭头指的方向走 {n0} 盆花，钥匙就压在你停下的那盆花下面。那盆花是什么颜色？（颜色名就写在每盆花的下方）

solution.en: Follow the arrow from the house and count the pots you pass — {n0} in all. The pot you stop at is the one with the key under it.
solution.zh: 从房子出发按箭头方向数花盆，一共走过 {n0} 盆。停下的那一盆下面就是钥匙，看图读出它的颜色。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 摆成阵列的蔬菜拿走一些

stem.en: The picture shows rows of vegetables. {t} of them are taken away. How many vegetables are left?
stem.zh: 图里的蔬菜排成整齐的几行。拿走 {t} 个以后，还剩多少个？

solution.en: The vegetables are in {r} rows of 6, so there are {6 * r} altogether. Take away {t}: {6 * r} - {t} = {6 * r - t}.
solution.zh: 蔬菜排成 {r} 行、每行 6 个，一共 {6 * r} 个。拿走 {t} 个：{6 * r} − {t} = {6 * r - t}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 把钟面和数字钟连起来

stem.en: Draw a line from each clock on the left to the digital clock on the right that shows the same time.
stem.zh: 把左边每个钟面和右边时间相同的电子钟连起来。

solution.en: On an analog clock the short hand shows the hour and the long hand shows the minutes. Read each clock, then join it to the digital clock with the same hours and minutes.
solution.zh: 模拟钟面上短针指小时，长针指分钟；长针指 12 是整点，指 6 是半点。照这样读出每个钟面的时刻，再连到右边数字相同的电子钟。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 箭头指着数轴上的哪个数（等分刻度）

stem.en: This number line goes from {B} to {E}, and the space in between is split into {n} equal intervals. Which number does the arrow point at?
stem.zh: 这条数轴从 {B} 到 {E}，中间平均分成了 {n} 格（每格一样大）。箭头指着的是哪个数？

solution.en: Do NOT count 1 per interval. First work out how much one interval is worth: {E} − {B} = {n * s}, shared equally between {n} intervals, so each interval is {n * s} ÷ {n} = {s}. The arrow sits on the {k}th interval: {B} + {k} × {s} = {ans}. (Counting 1 per mark would give {wrong1}, which is wrong.)
solution.zh: 不要一格数 1。先算出一格是多少：{E} − {B} = {n * s}，平均分成 {n} 格，每格 {n * s} ÷ {n} = {s}。箭头在第 {k} 格上，所以是 {B} + {k} × {s} = {ans}。（如果按「每格 1」去数会得到 {wrong1}，那是错的。）

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪一对图形不可能拿到

stem.en: One shape is taken from Box 1 and one shape from Box 2. Which pair of shapes could NOT be taken?
stem.zh: 从 Box 1（1 号盒子）里拿一个图形，再从 Box 2（2 号盒子）里拿一个图形。下面哪一对「不可能」拿到？

solution.en: Whatever you take, the first shape must come from Box 1 and the second from Box 2. Look for a pair whose second shape is not in Box 2 at all — that pair can never be taken. Any pair where the first shape is in Box 1 and the second is in Box 2 is possible.
solution.zh: 不管怎么拿，第一个图形必须来自 1 号盒子，第二个必须来自 2 号盒子。只要某一对里第二格那个图形根本不在 2 号盒子里，这一对就永远拿不到；其它几对两格都在相应的盒子里，都可能拿到。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 一排玩具车一共多长

stem.en: The picture shows {n} toy cars in a row. Each car is 5 cm long and the gap between two cars is 2 cm. How long is the whole row?
stem.zh: 图里 {n} 辆玩具车排成一行。每辆车长 5 厘米，车与车之间的间隔是 2 厘米。这一排从头到尾一共多长？

solution.en: The {n} cars take {n} × 5 = {5 * n} cm. Between {n} cars there are {n - 1} gaps, taking {n - 1} × 2 = {2 * (n - 1)} cm. Altogether {5 * n} + {2 * (n - 1)} = {5 * n + 2 * (n - 1)} cm.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 数一数用了几个小方块

stem.en: The solid is made of unit cubes. How many unit cubes are there altogether?
stem.zh: 这个立体图形是用同样大的小方块搭成的。一共用了多少个小方块？

solution.en: Count column by column. The front layer is {f0} + {f1} + {f2} + {f3} = {f0 + f1 + f2 + f3} cubes, and the back layer is {b0} + {b1} + {b2} + {b3} = {b0 + b1 + b2 + b3} cubes. Altogether {f0 + f1 + f2 + f3} + {b0 + b1 + b2 + b3} = {f0 + f1 + f2 + f3 + b0 + b1 + b2 + b3}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每组的泰迪每次多两只

stem.en: The number of bears goes up by two each time: Shape 1, then Shape 2. How many bears will be in Shape 3?
stem.zh: 每一组的泰迪都比前一组多 2 只：图上先画了 Shape 1（第 1 组），再画了 Shape 2（第 2 组）。第 3 组会有多少只泰迪？

solution.en: Count each group: Shape 1 has 2 rows of {c0} = {2 * c0} bears; Shape 2 has 2 rows of {c0 + 1} = {2 * (c0 + 1)} bears. That is 2 more each time, so Shape 3 has {2 * (c0 + 1)} + 2 = {2 * k1} bears — that is 2 rows of {k1}.
solution.zh: 先数每一组：第 1 组是 2 行、每行 {c0} 只，共 {2 * c0} 只；第 2 组是 2 行、每行 {c0 + 1} 只，共 {2 * (c0 + 1)} 只。每次多 2 只，所以第 3 组是 {2 * (c0 + 1)} + 2 = {2 * k1} 只，也就是 2 行、每行 {k1} 只。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪个图形的面积最小

stem.en: The three shapes are drawn on grid paper. Which shape has the smallest area?
stem.zh: 三个图形都画在方格纸上。哪个图形的面积最小？

solution.en: Count whole squares, and count two half-squares as one whole square. Yellow: {s0} squares + {t0} half-squares = {a0} half-squares; blue: {s1} + {t1} halves = {a1}; red: {s2} + {t2} halves = {a2}. The smallest is the one with the fewest half-squares.
solution.zh: 数整格，再把两个半格拼成一个整格。黄色：{s0} 个整格加 {t0} 个半格，合 {a0} 个半格；蓝色：{s1} 个整格加 {t1} 个半格，合 {a1} 个半格；红色：{s2} 个整格加 {t2} 个半格，合 {a2} 个半格。半格数最少的面积最小。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 先乘、再给出去、又买回来

stem.en: Mia has {r} boxes of pencils. Each box holds {b} pencils. She gives away {g} pencils and then buys {k} more. How many pencils does she have now?
stem.zh: 米娅有 {r} 盒铅笔，每盒 {b} 支。她送出 {g} 支，后来又买了 {k} 支。现在她一共有多少支铅笔？

solution.en: First find how many she starts with: {r} × {b} = {r * b}. Then give away {g}: {r * b} - {g} = {r * b - g}. Then add the {k} new ones: {r * b - g} + {k} = {r * b - g + k}.
solution.zh: 先算原来有多少支：{r} × {b} = {r * b} 支。送出 {g} 支：{r * b} − {g} = {r * b - g} 支。又买回 {k} 支：{r * b - g} + {k} = {r * b - g + k} 支。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪张柱状图画对了

stem.en: Tim, David and Amy picked some apples. David picked {dv} apples. Amy picked {kk} times as many apples as David. Tim picked {mm} more apples than Amy. Which graph shows the number of apples they each picked?
stem.zh: Tim（蒂姆）、David（戴维）和 Amy（艾米）摘苹果。David 摘了 {dv} 个；Amy 摘的个数是 David 的 {kk} 倍；Tim 比 Amy 多摘 {mm} 个。哪张柱状图表示的是他们三个人各摘了多少个？

solution.en: Work out the three numbers first — they are NOT written down for you. David picked {dv}. Amy picked {kk} times as many: {dv} × {kk} = {amy}. Tim picked {mm} more than Amy: {amy} + {mm} = {tim}. Only the graph whose bars read {tim}, {dv}, {amy} in the order Tim, David, Amy is right; each of the others has two of the children swapped.
solution.zh: 先把三个数算出来 —— 题目没有直接告诉你。David 摘了 {dv} 个；Amy 是它的 {kk} 倍：{dv} × {kk} = {amy} 个；Tim 比 Amy 多 {mm} 个：{amy} + {mm} = {tim} 个。只有 Tim、David、Amy 三根柱子依次是 {tim}、{dv}、{amy} 的那张图才是对的，其它几张都把两个人调换了。

templates.title: 哪瓶水正好装了一半

stem.en: Each bottle is the same size. Which one is half full?
stem.zh: 几个瓶子一样大。哪一瓶里的水正好是半瓶？

solution.en: Half of the bottle is the middle of it. The bottle is marked with {ridges} equal bands, so half way is at band {level}. The bottle whose water surface sits exactly on that middle band is half full; the others are too empty or too full.
solution.zh: 「一半」就是瓶子的一半高。瓶身上的小凹纹正好把它分成 {ridges} 格一样高的部分，所以半瓶的水面应该在第 {level} 格。水面正好停在这一格的才是半瓶，其它几瓶不是太少就是太多。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 按编号连线得到哪个图形

stem.en: Mia had this dot-to-dot picture: six dots, and every dot has a number on it. She joined the dots in the order of their numbers — 1 to 2, 2 to 3, and so on up to 6 — and then joined 6 back to 1. Which of these shows what Mia drew?
stem.zh: 米娅有一张连点图：6 个点，每个点上标着一个数字。她按数字的顺序把点连起来：1 连 2、2 连 3……一直连到 6，最后再从 6 连回 1。她画出来的是哪个图形？

solution.en: Find the dot numbered 1, then join the dots in order 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and finally from 6 back to 1. Only one of the four figures joins the dots in exactly that order. The others join them in a different order (going straight round the outside gives a hexagon; skipping every other dot gives a star). Check the figures one by one against the numbers.
solution.zh: 先找到标着 1 的那个点，再按 2、3、4、5、6 的顺序依次连过去，最后从 6 连回 1。四个图形里只有一个的连线顺序和编号完全一样；另外三个是按别的顺序连的（顺着外圈连会得到六边形，隔一个点连会得到五角星）。一幅一幅对着编号看。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 三角形里缺的那个数

stem.en: The three numbers outside a triangle add up to the number written inside it. What number is missing from the last triangle?
stem.zh: 每个三角形外面三个数相加，正好等于写在三角形里面的那个数。最后一个三角形缺的是几？

solution.en: Check the rule on the first three triangles: for example 4 + 8 + 2 = 14, and 14 is written inside. So for the last one, the three outside numbers must add up to {v}. Two of them are {bl} and {br}, and {bl} + {br} = {bl + br}, so the missing number is {v} - {bl + br} = {v - bl - br}.
solution.zh: 先用前三个三角形验证规律：比如 4 + 8 + 2 = 14，里面写的就正好是 14。最后一个三角形外面的三个数相加应该等于 {v}。现在已经知道两个数 {bl} 和 {br}，{bl} + {br} = {bl + br}，所以缺的那个数是 {v} − {bl + br} = {v - bl - br}。

templates.title: 两个人相差几岁

stem.en: Mum is {p} years old and Tom is {c} years old. What is the difference between their ages?
stem.zh: 妈妈 {p} 岁，汤姆 {c} 岁。两个人相差多少岁？

solution.en: "Difference" means how much more: {p} - {c} = {p - c}, so they are {p - c} years apart.
solution.zh: 「相差」就是多多少：{p} − {c} = {p - c}，两人相差 {p - c} 岁。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 射中靶心一共得几分

stem.en: In this game a dart scores the number written in the ring where it lands. Ravi threw {k} darts and every dart landed in the ring worth the most points. He was then given {b} bonus points, but {m} points were taken off for a dart that fell on the floor. What was his score?
stem.zh: 在这个游戏里，飞镖落在哪个环里就得那个环上写的分数。拉维扔了 {k} 支飞镖，每一支都落在得分最高的那个环里；后来裁判又给他加了 {b} 分，不过因为有一支飞镖掉在地上，扣掉了 {m} 分。拉维最后得了多少分？

solution.en: Look at the target: the rings are numbered 1 to 5, and the number gets bigger towards the middle, so the centre ring is worth 5. {k} darts in the centre score {k} × 5 = {k * 5}. Add the {b} bonus points: {k * 5} + {b} = {k * 5 + b}. Take off {m}: {k * 5 + b} - {m} = {k * 5 + b - m}.
solution.zh: 先看靶盘：环上的数从外到内是 1 到 5，越靠中间越大，所以得分最高的中心环是 5 分。{k} 支都落在中心：{k} × 5 = {k * 5} 分。加上 {b} 分奖励：{k * 5} + {b} = {k * 5 + b}。再扣掉 {m} 分：{k * 5 + b} − {m} = {k * 5 + b - m} 分。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 停车场上共有多少辆车

stem.en: The picture graph shows the cars in a car park. One car picture stands for {ka} cars. How many cars are there altogether?
stem.zh: 象形统计图画的是停车场里的车。右边 KEY 框里写着：每个小汽车代表 {ka} 辆真车。停车场上共有多少辆车？

solution.en: Count the car pictures: {a} + {b} + {c} = {a + b + c} pictures. Each picture stands for {ka} cars (the KEY box tells you), so {a + b + c} × {ka} = {(a + b + c) * ka} cars.
solution.zh: 先数图上小汽车的个数：{a} + {b} + {c} = {a + b + c} 个。再看右边的 KEY：每个小汽车代表 {ka} 辆真车。所以一共 {a + b + c} × {ka} = {(a + b + c) * ka} 辆。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 只和三个六边形相接的有几块

stem.en: These hexagons fit together like tiles, and every hexagon is painted the same colour. How many hexagons are touching ONLY three other hexagons?
stem.zh: 这些六边形像瓷砖一样拼在一起，每一块颜色都一样。有几个六边形只和 3 个其它六边形相接（不是 4 个、也不是 6 个）？

solution.en: Count, for each hexagon in the picture, how many other hexagons it shares an edge with (a hexagon can share at most six). Do not skip the ones along the outside edge — a hexagon in a corner touches fewer than the ones buried in the middle. The number touching only three others is {cnt}.
solution.zh: 对着图一块一块地数：数它和几个其它六边形共用一条边（最多 6 个）。别漏掉外圈那些 —— 挤在中间的接得多，边角上的接得少。只和 3 个相接的一共 {cnt} 块。

templates.title: 飞走一些又回来一些

stem.en: There were {a} birds in a tree. {b} of them flew away and then {c} birds came back. How many birds are in the tree now?
stem.zh: 树上原来有 {a} 只鸟，飞走了 {b} 只，后来又飞回来 {c} 只。现在树上有多少只鸟？

solution.en: Write it as one number sentence: {a} - {b} + {c}. Work from the left: {a} - {b} = {a - b}, then {a - b} + {c} = {a - b + c}.
solution.zh: 把它写成一个算式：{a} − {b} + {c}。从左往右算：{a} − {b} = {a - b}，再 {a - b} + {c} = {a - b + c}。

templates.title: 按距离条件推出四栋房子各住谁

stem.en: Pete, Sita, Lin and Ben are friends. They live in these four houses (look at how far apart the houses are, and where the tree is). {X} and {Y} each live {U1} paces from {Z}. {Z} and {Y} each live {U2} paces from {W}. Which list gives the four children in the order of the houses from LEFT to RIGHT?
stem.zh: Pete（皮特）、Sita（西塔）、Lin（林）和 Ben（本）住在这四栋房子里（注意房子之间的距离，还有大树的位置）。{X} 和 {Y} 离 {Z} 都是 {U1} 步；{Z} 和 {Y} 离 {W} 都是 {U2} 步。从左到右，这四栋房子里依次住的是谁？

solution.en: The houses are NOT equally spaced — the widest gap is where the tree stands, so the figure tells you which end of the row has the big space. {X} and {Y} are each {U1} paces from {Z}, so they must be the two houses that are {U1} apart from {Z} (one on each side of the row). {Y} is also {U2} paces from {W}, so {W} has to be the house next to {Y}. Putting those together leaves only one arrangement: {a1}, {a2}, {a3}, {a4}.
solution.zh: 四栋房子之间的距离并不一样 —— 大树站在最宽的那段空隙里，所以看图就能知道「宽的那段在哪一头」。{X} 和 {Y} 离 {Z} 都是 {U1} 步，说明它们就是离 {Z} 有 {U1} 步的那两栋（一左一右）。{Y} 离 {W} 又是 {U2} 步，所以 {W} 只能紧挨着 {Y}。合起来只剩一种排法：{a1}、{a2}、{a3}、{a4}。

stem.en: Pirate Pete had {T} gold pieces in his treasure chest. On the first day he took out {a} gold pieces. Each day after that he took out {d} MORE gold pieces than he had taken out the day before. The table shows the first 3 days. On which day did Pirate Pete empty the treasure chest?
stem.zh: 海盗皮特的宝箱里原有 {T} 枚金币。第一天他取出 {a} 枚；以后每天取出的枚数都比前一天多 {d} 枚。表格给出的是前三天。第几天他会把宝箱取空？

solution.en: The amounts taken out are {a}, {a + d}, {a + 2 * d}, … — the same number ({d}) MORE every day, so it is an arithmetic pattern, not a fixed amount per day. Keep adding a day at a time until the total reaches {T}: it lands on exactly {T} on day {n}, so the chest is empty after day {n}.
solution.zh: 每天取出的枚数是 {a}、{a + d}、{a + 2 * d}……每天多 {d} 枚，是等差数列（不是每天都取一样多）。一天一天往下加，加到第 {n} 天正好是 {T} 枚，所以第 {n} 天取空。

templates.title: 小房子屋顶的数（下面两格相乘再减 1）

stem.en: Find the missing number in the number puzzle below.

templates.title: 线段数依次多 1，下一个图形是哪个

stem.en: The figures below follow a pattern. Which diagram comes next?
stem.zh: 下面的图形按规律排列，下一个图形是哪一个？

solution.en: Count the straight line segments in each figure: the first has {s}, the second {s+1}, the third {s+2}. The number of segments goes up by 1 each time, so the next figure must be made of {T} straight segments — that is the {T}-sided one.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 给整本书编页码一共用了多少个数字

stem.en: A comic book has {N} pages. How many digits in total are used to number all the pages?
stem.zh: 一本漫画书有 {N} 页，给全部页码编号一共要用多少个数字？

solution.en: Pages 1 to 9 use one digit each: 9 digits. The rest are two-digit page numbers. There are {N} − 9 = {N-9} of them, using {N-9} × 2 = {2*(N-9)} digits. Altogether 9 + {2*(N-9)} = {T} digits.
solution.zh: 第 1–9 页每页 1 个数字，共 9 个；剩下的都是两位数页码，共 {N}−9 = {N-9} 页，每页 2 个数字，共 {2*(N-9)} 个。合计 9+{2*(N-9)} = {T} 个。

templates.title: 三角形数字阵第 n 行最后一个数

stem.en: In the number pattern below, what is the last number in the {n}th row?
stem.zh: 下图的数字排列中，第 {n} 行的最后一个数是多少？

solution.en: Row 1 holds 1 number, row 2 holds 2, row 3 holds 3, and so on. The first {n} rows together hold 1 + 2 + … + {n} = {T} numbers, and the numbers are written in order 1, 2, 3, … So the last number in row {n} is {T}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每人多给 1 颗就差一点：一共几颗糖

stem.en: Lily has some sweets. If she gives each child {p} sweets, she has {r} sweets left. If she gives each child {p+1} sweets, she is short by {s}. How many sweets does Lily have?
stem.zh: Lily 有一些糖。如果给每个孩子 {p} 颗，还剩 {r} 颗；如果给每个孩子 {p+1} 颗，还差 {s} 颗。Lily 一共有多少颗糖？

solution.en: From the first plan to the second, each child gets 1 sweet more, so the sweets total would have to grow by one per child. Going from {r} left over to {s} short means the total needed changed by {r}+{s} = {c}, so there are {c} children. Then the sweets are {p} × {c} + {r} = {T}. (Check: {p+1} × {c} = {(p+1)*c}, which is {T} + {s}.)
solution.zh: 从第一种分法到第二种，每个孩子多拿 1 颗。糖数从「剩 {r} 颗」变成「差 {s} 颗」，中间相差 {r}+{s} = {c} 颗，也就是差在每个孩子多拿的 1 颗上，所以孩子有 {c} 个。糖数 = {p}×{c}+{r} = {T}。（验算：{p+1}×{c} = {(p+1)*c}，正好比 {T} 多 {s} 颗。）

templates.title: 一共几只兔（头数与腿数已知）

stem.en: The farmer has {A} chickens and rabbits. He counted that there are {L} legs altogether. How many rabbits does the farmer have?
stem.zh: 农夫养了 {A} 只鸡和兔子，一共数出 {L} 条腿。兔子有多少只？

solution.en: Pretend all {A} animals were chickens: that is 2 × {A} = {2*A} legs. The real count is {L}, which is {L-2*A} more legs. Every rabbit adds 2 legs more than a chicken, so the number of rabbits is {L-2*A} ÷ 2 = {R}.
solution.zh: 假设 {A} 只全是鸡，那么腿是 2×{A} = {2*A} 条；实际有 {L} 条，多出 {L-2*A} 条。每把一只鸡换成兔子就多 2 条腿，所以兔子有 {L-2*A}÷2 = {R} 只。

templates.title: 按箭头逆推第 1 个圆圈里的数

stem.zh: 下图中，第 1 个圆圈里应该填哪个数？

solution.en: Work backwards from the number you can see, {F}, undoing each arrow: {F} × {q} = {F*q}; {F*q} + {r} = {F*q+r}; {F*q+r} ÷ {q} = {F+s}; {F+s} − {p} = {a}. So the 1st circle holds {a}. (Forward check: {a} + {p} = {a+p}, × {q} = {(a+p)*q}, − {r} = {(a+p)*q-r}, ÷ {q} = {F}.)

templates.title: 2 月 1 日是星期几，3 月 1 日又是星期几

stem.en: The 1st of February fell on a {sd} some years ago. On which day of the week was the 1st of March in that same year? There are {D} days in February that year. You may use the table to assist you.
stem.zh: 若干年前，2 月 1 日是{zd}。那一年 3 月 1 日是星期几？（那一年 2 月有 {D} 天。可以借助表格推算。）

derived.sd: sel(w, d0, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5, d6)
derived.zd: sel(w, z0, z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6)
derived.sy: sel(mod(w+D,7), d0, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5, d6)
derived.zy: sel(mod(w+D,7), z0, z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6)

solution.en: February has {D} days. {D} ÷ 7 = {floor(D/7)} week(s) with {mod(D,7)} day(s) left over, so the weekday moves on by {mod(D,7)} from the 1st of February to the 1st of March. Starting from {sd} and moving on {mod(D,7)} day(s) gives {sy}.
solution.zh: 2 月有 {D} 天。{D}÷7 = {floor(D/7)} 周余 {mod(D,7)} 天，所以从 2 月 1 日到 3 月 1 日，星期往后推 {mod(D,7)} 天。从{zd}往后数 {mod(D,7)} 天，得到{zy}。

templates.title: 3×3 方阵里每行每列都加同一个数

stem.en: Find the missing number in the number puzzle below.
stem.zh: 求下面数字方阵中缺失的数。

solution.en: Going one square to the right, or one square down, the number goes up by {step}. The top-left square is {base}. To reach the missing square you move {mr} step(s) down and {mc} step(s) right, so the number is {base} + ({mr}+{mc}) × {step} = {T}.
solution.zh: 每向右一格、或向下一格，数都增加 {step}。左上角是 {base}。缺的那格在左上角往下 {mr} 格、往右 {mc} 格，所以是 {base}+({mr}+{mc})×{step} = {T}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 三架天平：一串葡萄有多重

stem.en: The three balances below are all in balance. What is the mass, in grams, of a bunch of grapes?
stem.zh: 下面三架天平都是平衡的。一串葡萄的质量是多少克？

solution.en: Start with the balance that has the weights: {na} apples = {W} g, so 1 apple = {W} ÷ {na} = {A} g. Next, 1 banana = {nb} apples = {nb} × {A} = {B} g. Finally, 1 bunch of grapes = {nc} bananas = {nc} × {B} = {T} g.
solution.zh: 先从有砝码的那架天平入手：{na} 个苹果 = {W} g，所以 1 个苹果 = {W}÷{na} = {A} g。接着 1 根香蕉 = {nb} 个苹果 = {nb}×{A} = {B} g。最后一串葡萄 = {nc} 根香蕉 = {nc}×{B} = {T} g。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 台阶形格线：从 A 到 B 的最短路径有多少条

stem.en: Find the number of shortest paths from A to B using the gridlines shown below.
stem.zh: 沿着下图中的格线，从 A 到 B 的最短路径有多少条？

solution.en: A shortest path only ever goes right or up. Write on each grid point how many ways there are to reach it: the start A gets 1, and every other point gets the sum of the point on its left and the point below it (a point with no such neighbour gets 0). Doing this along the whole staircase, B gets {T}. So there are {T} shortest paths.
solution.zh: 最短路径只会向右或向上走。在每个格点上写下「走到这里的方法数」：起点 A 记 1；其余每个格点 = 它左边格点 + 它下面格点（某个方向没有格线可走就记 0）。把整个台阶形格线标完，B 点是 {T}，所以一共有 {T} 条最短路径。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 圈乘号 ⊗ 是按什么规则算的

stem.en: The diagram below uses a special rule for ⊗. Find the value of {a4} ⊗ {b4}.
stem.zh: 下图的 ⊗ 是一种自定义运算。求 {a4} ⊗ {b4} 的值。

solution.en: Try {a1} ⊗ {b1} = {r1}: the second number {b1} times (the first number + 1) gives {b1} × {a1+1} = {r1}. Check with the next two: {b2} × {a2+1} = {r2} and {b3} × {a3+1} = {r3}. Both work, so the rule is a ⊗ b = b × (a+1). Therefore {a4} ⊗ {b4} = {b4} × {a4+1} = {T}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每行第三个图形＝前两个图形的线段叠加

stem.en: Find the missing figure in the diagram below.
stem.zh: 找出下图中缺失的那个图形。

solution.en: Look at the first two rows. In each row, draw all the line segments of the 1st figure and all the line segments of the 2nd figure on top of each other — that is exactly the 3rd figure (segments that appear in both are still only drawn once). So the missing figure is the 1st and 2nd figures of the last row put together.
solution.zh: 先看前两行：每一行把第 1 个图形的所有线段和第 2 个图形的所有线段画在一起（重叠的线段只画一次），得到的正好是第 3 个图形。所以缺的那个，就是把最后一行第 1、2 个图形的线段合在一起。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 大三角形里一共能数出多少个三角形

stem.en: How many triangles are there in the figure below?
stem.zh: 下图中共有多少个三角形？

solution.en: Don't count one by one — split the triangles into two groups. (1) Those that do NOT use the extra slant line: pick any 2 of the {j+2} lines fanning out from A (the bottom-left corner) and they cut off a triangle with part of BC — {j+2}×{j+1}÷2 = {partA} triangles. (2) Those that DO use the extra slant line: that line carries {j+2} points (the midpoint of AB, its {j} crossings with the lines from A, and the bottom-right corner); choosing any 2 of them together with A gives another {partA} triangles, and {j+1} more have their corners taken from the two ends of the slant line and the two other corners (so A is not a vertex). (3) Total: {partA} + {partA} + {j+1} = {T}.
solution.zh: 数三角形不能一个一个数，要分类数。① **不用**中间那条斜线的：A（左下角）出发的 {j+2} 条线里任取 2 条，就和 BC 边上的一段围成三角形，共 {j+2}×{j+1}÷2 = {partA} 个。② **用**中间那条斜线的：这条斜线上有 {j+2} 个点（A 边中点、它和 {j} 条线的交点、右下角顶点），任取 2 个点再和 A 又能围出 {partA} 个；另外斜线两端和另外两个顶点还能围出 {j+1} 个（这些不以 A 为顶点）。③ 一共 {partA}+{partA}+{j+1} = {T} 个。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 一次上 1 级或 2 级，上楼梯有几种走法

stem.en: There are {n} steps in a flight of stairs. Cindy can go up by either taking 1 step or 2 steps at a time. How many ways are there for her to climb the staircase?
stem.zh: 一段楼梯有 {n} 级。Cindy 每次可以上 1 级或 2 级，她一共有多少种上楼梯的方法？

solution.en: Let f(k) be the number of ways to climb k steps. The last move is either 1 step (leaving k−1 steps) or 2 steps (leaving k−2 steps), so f(k) = f(k−1) + f(k−2). With f(1) = 1 and f(2) = 2, we get f(3)=3, f(4)=5, f(5)=8, f(6)=13, f(7)=21, f(8)=34, f(9)=55, f(10)=89. So for {n} steps there are {T} ways.
solution.zh: 设上 k 级有 f(k) 种走法。最后一步只能是上 1 级（前面剩 k−1 级）或上 2 级（前面剩 k−2 级），所以 f(k) = f(k−1) + f(k−2)。已知 f(1)=1、f(2)=2，往后算：f(3)=3、f(4)=5、f(5)=8、f(6)=13、f(7)=21、f(8)=34、f(9)=55、f(10)=89。所以 {n} 级楼梯共有 {T} 种走法。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 四个钟面：间隔一次比一次多 10 分钟

stem.en: What is the time shown on the last clock?
stem.zh: 最后一个钟面上显示的是几点？

solution.en: Read the three times given: {h1}:{p1} PM, {h2}:{p2} PM and {h3x}:{p3} PM. Compare them in pairs: the 1st to the 2nd is {G} minutes, the 2nd to the 3rd is {G+10} minutes — the gap grows by 10 minutes each time. So the next gap is {G+20} minutes, and the last clock shows {T} minutes after the 3rd one, which is {h3}:{ms} PM. (The last clock has no hands — you work it out from the pattern.)
solution.zh: 先读出图上给的前三个时刻：{h1}:{p1} PM、{h2}:{p2} PM、{h3x}:{p3} PM。两两比较：第 1 个到第 2 个相隔 {G} 分钟，第 2 个到第 3 个相隔 {G+10} 分钟——间隔每次多 10 分钟。所以下一次间隔 {G+20} 分钟，最后一个钟面 = 第 3 个钟面往后 {G+20} 分钟 = {h3}:{ms} PM。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 至少摸出几个球才能保证有 n 个同色

stem.en: There are {c1} green, {c2} white, {c3} red and {c4} orange balls in a bag. Shawn is blind-folded. He was asked to select balls from the bag. At least how many balls must he select to ensure that he will have {n} balls of the same colour?
stem.zh: 袋子里有 {c1} 个绿球、{c2} 个白球、{c3} 个红球和 {c4} 个橙球。Shawn 蒙着眼睛摸球，至少要摸出多少个球，才能保证其中有 {n} 个同色？

solution.en: Think of the worst luck: he keeps taking colours that stop one short of {n}. He can take at most {min(c1,n-1)} green, {min(c2,n-1)} white, {min(c3,n-1)} red and {min(c4,n-1)} orange — that is {min(c1,n-1)}+{min(c2,n-1)}+{min(c3,n-1)}+{min(c4,n-1)} balls with no {n} of a colour. One more ball must then complete a colour, so the answer is {min(c1,n-1)+min(c2,n-1)+min(c3,n-1)+min(c4,n-1)} + 1 = {T}.
solution.zh: 考虑最不走运的情况：每次摸到的颜色都差 1 个才凑够 {n} 个。这时绿球最多摸 {min(c1,n-1)} 个、白球最多 {min(c2,n-1)} 个、红球最多 {min(c3,n-1)} 个、橙球最多 {min(c4,n-1)} 个，共 {min(c1,n-1)}+{min(c2,n-1)}+{min(c3,n-1)}+{min(c4,n-1)} 个，还没有 {n} 个同色。再多摸 1 个，无论什么颜色都必然凑够 {n} 个同色。所以至少 {min(c1,n-1)+min(c2,n-1)+min(c3,n-1)+min(c4,n-1)} + 1 = {T} 个。

templates.title: 三个符号两两相加，求其中一个

stem.en: The three equations below use the symbols ◆, ▲ and ○. Find the value of ○.
stem.zh: 下面的三个等式里用了 ◆、▲、○ 三种符号。求 ○ 的值。

solution.en: Add the three equations together: (◆+○) + (▲+◆) + (▲+○) = {P} + {Q} + {R} = {P+Q+R}. On the left, every symbol appears exactly twice, so that is 2 × (▲+◆+○). Hence ▲+◆+○ = {P+Q+R} ÷ 2 = {(P+Q+R)/2}. The 2nd equation tells us ▲+◆ = {Q}, so ○ = {(P+Q+R)/2} − {Q} = {y}.
